claim_scope: Research-only evidence that behavior-bearing subclasses are rejected at the earliest exact-ownership boundary and remain rejected if deliberately injected after construction. The tests preserve callback non-execution and point-of-use revalidation without weakening the GlobalSettlementABI V1 ownership rule.
failure_modes: a test constructs a forbidden subclass and accidentally treats earlier rejection as a regression
a policy or registry subclass executes its canonical projection before exact-type admission
post-construction corruption reaches membership, receipt verification, or a verifier callback
a hostile root or token subclass influences equality or canonical identity

aaa.reason: Each node arranges one exact valid object and one behavior-bearing subclass, attempts either direct admission or deliberate post-construction corruption, and asserts the exact early rejection plus hook or callback non-execution where observable.

reject_is_noop.reason: These are constructor, snapshot, membership, and receipt-admission boundaries. They reject before an authoritative transition or external effect plan can be produced; the shared transition suite separately checks rejected-transition no-op behavior.

boundary_dimensions.name: injection_time
points: subclass injected after construction and before point-of-use snapshot

mutations.description: restore subtype-permitting policy and registry admission
omit point-of-use scalar revalidation after retained-object corruption
dispatch a receipt verifier callback before owning its nested journal scalars

nonclaims: This packet grants no production, settlement, release, migration, proof-receipt, or value-moving authority.
Earlier rejection changes error precedence for forbidden caller-constructed subclass values only; valid exact-value canonical bytes are unchanged.
This evidence does not close the generic canonicalizable registry, traversal budget, local lane ownership, sole-publisher, durability, or no-bypass gaps.
Passing the hygiene gate establishes only current source/test binding and execution of the declared nodes.
